obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line
obligations.ears: In the two vehicle-loading conditions, the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: may either be secured to a carriage (moving barrier) or form part of a pendulum
obligations.ears: The impactor may either be secured to a carriage (moving barrier) or form part of a pendulum.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: the latter must be rigid and be incapable of being deformed by the impact; the carriage shall at the moment of impact be capable of moving freely and no longer be subject to the action of the propelling device
obligations.ears: If the impactor is secured to a carriage (moving barrier) by a restraining element, the restraining element must be rigid and be incapable of being deformed by the impact, and the carriage shall at the moment of impact be capable of moving freely and no longer be subject to the action of the propelling device.

derived.text: If the impactor is secured to a carriage (moving barrier) by a restraining element, the restraining element must be rigid and be incapable of being deformed by the impact.

If the impactor is secured to a carriage (moving barrier) by a restraining element, the carriage shall at the moment of impact be capable of moving freely and no longer be subject to the action of the propelling device.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: The distance between the pivot and the centre of percussion shall be at least 3.3 m.
obligations.ears: Where a pendulum is used, the distance between the pivot and the centre of percussion shall be at least 3.3 m.

obligations.subject: e4
obligations.response: shall coincide with the centre of percussion
obligations.ears: Where a pendulum is used, the reference line shall coincide with the centre of percussion.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: Plane A of the pendulum shall remain parallel with its axis of rotation throughout the test.
obligations.ears: Where a pendulum is used, plane A of the pendulum shall remain parallel with its axis of rotation throughout the test.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m
obligations.ears: In the case of a parallelogram-suspended pendulum, the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: for the second impact the median plane of the impactor shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first
obligations.exception: provided that during these impacts the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle
obligations.ears: For the impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the choice of location of the impactor for the first impact is free, but for the second impact the median plane of the impactor shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first, provided that during these impacts the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: the following conditions shall be met
obligations.ears: In the corner impact test, the following conditions shall be met.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle
obligations.ears: In the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm)
obligations.ears: In the corner impact test, the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
